blocks.text: As Cebu begins its Christmas preparations, Filipino families are once again making space for one of the season’s most enduring symbols: the Belen, or Nativity scene. Depicting the birth of Jesus, the Belen has long been part of Filipino Christmas traditions, appearing in homes, churches, schools and public spaces. It continues to give families a way to remember the story of Christmas while passing a familiar tradition from one generation to the next.
